name: BAMA TEA Co., Ltd.
summary: BAMA TEA Co., Ltd. produces, processes, and sells tea leaves and other tea products in China. The company tea, which includes Oolong tea, black tea, dark tea, white tea, green tea, and yellow tea; tea-related derivatives, such as tea ware, tea snacks, and tea beverages. It offers its products under the Bama brand name. In addition, the company provides liquor, incense sticks, tea toys, pre-opening training services, as well as tea lounge services and franchises. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Shenzhen, China.
